abstract_sentences.text: Vision language models (VLMs) can flexibly address various vision tasks through text interactions.

evidence.anchor: flexibly address various vision tasks through text interactions

abstract_sentences.text: Although successful in semantic understanding, state-of-the-art VLMs including GPT-5 still struggle in understanding 3D from 2D inputs.

evidence.anchor: still struggle in understanding 3D from 2D inputs

abstract_sentences.text: On the other hand, expert pure vision models achieve super-human accuracy in metric depth estimation, a key 3D understanding task.

evidence.anchor: expert pure vision models achieve super-human accuracy

abstract_sentences.text: However, they require task-specific architectures and losses.

evidence.anchor: require task-specific architectures and losses

abstract_sentences.text: Such difference motivates us to ask: Can VLMs reach expert-level accuracy without architecture or loss change?

evidence.anchor: reach expert-level accuracy without architecture or loss change

abstract_sentences.text: We take per-pixel metric depth estimation as the representative task and show that the answer is yes!

evidence.anchor: per-pixel metric depth estimation as the representative task

abstract_sentences.text: Surprisingly, comprehensive analysis shows that text-based supervised-finetuning with sparse labels is sufficient for VLMs to unlock strong 3D understanding, no dense prediction head or complex regression/regularization loss is needed.

evidence.anchor: text-based supervised-finetuning with sparse labels is sufficient

abstract_sentences.text: The bottleneck lies in pixel reference and cross-dataset camera ambiguity, which we address through visual prompting and intrinsic-conditioned augmentation.

evidence.anchor: bottleneck lies in pixel reference and cross-dataset camera ambiguity

abstract_sentences.text: With much smaller models, our method DepthLM surpasses the accuracy of most advanced VLMs by over 2x, making VLMs for the first time comparable with pure vision models.

evidence.anchor: surpasses the accuracy of most advanced VLMs by over 2x

abstract_sentences.text: The simplicity of DepthLM also enables a single VLM to cover various 3D tasks beyond metric depth.

evidence.anchor: a single VLM to cover various 3D tasks beyond metric depth

abstract_sentences.text: Code and model are available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/DepthLM_Official.

evidence.anchor: Code and model are available

not due to the lack of dense prediction head or complex regression/regularization losses

unifying the focal length doubles the accuracy of other approaches

increasing label density … hurts the performance

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 VLM 的 metric-depth 差距拆成 pixel reference 与跨相机尺度两个瓶颈，用 marker、intrinsics-conditioned resize 和普通 text-SFT 组合，在 3B/7B 上取得 .824/.838 八集 δ1，并扩展到六类 3D 任务（p.4–8 §3.1–§4，Table 1）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Finding 1–4、Figure 2–5 的控制曲线、resize 公式、训练预算、Tables 1–3 平均结果和 Figure 8 形态对照，分别承担机制选择、主性能和多任务决策（p.4–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: A.1–A.7 移出 marker 细节、数据量、cross-dataset SFT/GRPO、超参数、相机 prompt 与逐集多任务表；主线仍自足，但复现 GRPO/相机 prompt 和识别异质性需附录（p.14–15）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先将替代解释做成小规模诊断，再把每个 Finding 映射为最终方法部件；简单 δ1 曲线、Figure 6 数据流和 Tables 1–3 的统一比较最有效（p.4–8）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “无需 architecture/loss”与“camera ambiguity 已解决”的因果范围缺少 head/loss 反事实、intrinsics 缺失部署、seed/误差/失败分布；Table 2 的 UniDepthV2 仍比 Ours 高 9.2%（p.6–8）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 对统一模型主张逐一操纵输入参照、尺度、训练密度等替代因素；正文给最小控制图和机制公式，附录给 prompt、超参数和逐单元异质性（p.4–8、p.14–15）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 规则适用于坐标或尺度混淆的统一视觉接口；若 intrinsics 不可得、相机非无畸变 pinhole、任务需 dense output 或要证明全面超过最佳专家模型，必须补部署/失败/共同评测证据（p.6–9）。
